simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to תּוֹעָה (H8442) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-f.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: תּוֹעָה (tôwʻâh) means mistake , i.e. (morally) impiety , or (political) injury First listed occurrence: Isa 32 6.

definitions.full: H8442. toah תּוֺעָה noun feminine wandering, error ; — 1 error in morals and religion, with דִּבֶּר , Isa 32:6 . 2 confusion, disturbance , with עָשָׂה , Neh 4:2 . תֹּ֫עוּ see תֹּעִי . תְּעוּדָה see [ עוד ] below
